method: Closed-loop linear grey-box prediction-error identification with an estimated innovation disturbance model, fixed actuator delay family, whole-experiment two-fold validation, explicit historical force-frame sign reconstruction, and corrected-controller robust tuning.

feedback_check.interpretation: A detected loop means the actuator command is correlated with output noise; an innovation disturbance model is required.

closed_loop_identification.method: greyest prediction-error method with DisturbanceModel=estimate; two-fold validation holds out complete experiment segments
closed_loop_identification.free_flight_conversion: Tether stiffness is set to zero and passive damping is not credited during robust tuning.

controller_in_loop_tuning.current_firmware_linearization: Corrected source: Ctheta=-(T+Kp)/T with pitch frame sign +1; Cq=Kd/(T*lever).
controller_in_loop_tuning.effectiveness_source: measured-PWM grey-box fallback because whole-experiment closed-loop validation failed
controller_in_loop_tuning.failure_reason: Nominal candidates failed at least one uncertainty corner (delay, servo tau, inertia, force, or effectiveness).

commissioning_candidate.usage: Restrained low-thrust commissioning start only; not validated for free flight.

previous_simple_pidtuner.warning: The previous result omitted the force-frame geometric feedback and is comparison-only.
